v2-1768394817652-uewrwobpf.name: Tulum
v2-1768394817652-uewrwobpf.description: A coastal resort town in Mexico's Yucatán Peninsula, known for its Mayan ruins and vibrant nightlife.

v2-1768394817652-90gkbgrnt.name: Zero Day Festival Entrance
v2-1768394817652-90gkbgrnt.description: The bustling, decorated entrance to the Zero Day Festival, alive with music and crowds under the warm afternoon sun.

v2-1768394868245-ly9ndx04p.name: Zero Day Festival
v2-1768394868245-ly9ndx04p.description: The vibrant and immersive grounds of the Zero Day Festival, a celebration of music and culture set against a tropical backdrop.
forbiddenTransformations: The festival grounds appearing sterile or lacking in decorative elements.
The jungle foliage being absent or not integrated with the festival structures.
The atmosphere becoming subdued or devoid of energy.
The color palette shifting away from warm yellows, oranges, and blues.

v2-1768394868245-8wu1um70s.name: Festival Main Area
v2-1768394868245-8wu1um70s.description: The heart of the Zero Day Festival, alive with the sounds of music, colorful decorations, and a lively throng of festival-goers.

promptLayers.background: Distant structures of temporary festival stages and vendor stalls, adorned with vibrant, patterned banners in warm yellows, oranges, and deep blues, interspersed with lush, artfully arranged jungle foliage. The canopy above is a lattice of fabric and perhaps some structural elements, allowing dappled sunlight to filter through.
promptLayers.midground: The main festival thoroughfares, teeming with people milling about. Elaborate, temporarily erected structures with intricate Mayan-inspired designs are visible. More jungle plants are woven into the decor, creating a sense of organic integration. Paths are worn smooth by foot traffic.
promptLayers.foreground: Close-up views of the sun-dappled ground, with fallen palm fronds or bright tropical flowers at the edge of the path. People's feet and legs moving through the space, perhaps a glimpse of colorful festival attire.
promptLayers.lighting: Sunlight filtering through gaps in the semi-enclosed canopy, creating dynamic sun-dappled patterns on the ground and structures. The warm hues of the banners and decorations subtly reflect this light. Occasional, softer glow from decorative festival lights might be present, complementing the natural sunlight.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A palpable sense of joyous energy and communal celebration. The implied sound of distant music and a happy murmur of voices contribute to the vibrant, enchanting atmosphere within this tropical paradise.

forbiddenTransformations: The canopy overhead becoming a solid, opaque roof, blocking all natural light.
The vibrant banners being replaced with plain or single-colored fabrics.
The jungle foliage disappearing or appearing artificial.
The ground becoming bare concrete or asphalt without any sun-dappling.
The atmosphere shifting to quiet or somber.
Modern, minimalist architectural elements intruding into the space.

v2-1768395060657-jic50c87g.name: Festival Plaza
v2-1768395060657-jic50c87g.description: The heart of the Zero Day Festival, this expansive open plaza teems with life and color. Intricate decorations and art installations create a dazzling spectacle under the bright afternoon sun.

promptLayers.background: The lush, silhouette of Mayan jungle foliage against a brilliant azure sky. Distant, artfully integrated festival banners peek through the dense greenery.
promptLayers.midground: Vibrant temporary structures adorned with warm yellow, orange, and deep blue banners. Intricate Mayan-inspired designs are visible on facades. People mingle and move through the space, creating a dynamic flow.
promptLayers.foreground: The sun-dappled ground of the plaza, with hints of colorful festival footwear and stray tropical leaves. The edges of the space blend into more dense jungle foliage.
promptLayers.lighting: Bright, direct afternoon sunlight casting sharp, dynamic shadows. Sun-dappled patterns are scattered across the ground and structures, highlighting the vibrant colors.
promptLayers.atmosphere: The air hums with the implied sounds of music and cheerful chatter. An overwhelming sense of joyous energy and vibrant celebration permeates the space.

forbiddenTransformations: The plaza becoming enclosed by solid walls or a solid roof.
The sky becoming obscured or replaced by artificial lighting.
The vibrant banners and decorations being removed or replaced with drab materials.
The presence of heavy, permanent architectural structures.
The jungle foliage being absent or replaced by urban plants.
The atmosphere shifting to quiet, somber, or monotonous.

v2-1768395126483-e28qpdfpb.name: The Dance Floor Under the Stars
v2-1768395126483-e28qpdfpb.description: An open-air dance floor nestled amidst the festival grounds, illuminated by the vibrant glow of stage lights and the vast expanse of the night sky.

banned: Silence or lack of implied music

promptLayers.background: Distant silhouettes of Mayan jungle foliage, now under a vast, star-speckled indigo night sky. Faint, pulsing lights from further festival areas can be seen in the far distance.
promptLayers.midground: The main dance floor area, packed with revelers. Large, artfully decorated festival stages with vibrant banners in warm yellows, oranges, and deep blues dominate the midground, casting dynamic, colored light. Jungle foliage is woven through the decorative elements, creating a unique fusion.
promptLayers.foreground: The immediate area of the dance floor, showing the energetic movement of festival-goers. The ground might be a mix of packed earth and scattered decorative elements. Hints of stray palm fronds or tropical flowers are still visible at the edges.
promptLayers.lighting: A dynamic interplay of vibrant stage lighting in intense hues of blue, purple, and yellow, casting sharp, colored shadows. The overall illumination is energetic and pulsating, contrasting with the deep, natural light of the stars and moon above. Warm hues from nearby banners reflect onto surfaces.
promptLayers.atmosphere: Exhilarating and communal. The air thrums with the beat of music and the collective energy of the dancing crowd. It feels magical, a vibrant, pulsating heart of celebration under the celestial canvas.

forbiddenTransformations: The sky becoming obscured by a solid roof or structure
The vibrant stage lighting being replaced by dim, uniform ambient light
The crowd dispersing, leaving the dance floor empty
The integration of jungle foliage disappearing
The temperature feeling anything other than warm and tropical
The Mayan art motifs being absent from the festival structures

v2-1768395804720-24esuvg4s.name: The Chill Out Area
v2-1768395804720-24esuvg4s.description: A serene oasis within the festival's energy, this area offers plush seating and ambient sounds. Soft lighting filters through woven canopies, creating a tranquil escape.

promptLayers.background: Distant, softly lit festival banners and integrated jungle foliage seen through a patterned, woven canopy overhead. The ceiling is a lattice of bamboo and lush vines.
promptLayers.midground: Oversized, comfortable seating arrangements covered in soft, muted textiles. Low tables with intricate, perhaps Mayan-inspired, carvings. Soft ambient lights are integrated into decorative elements.
promptLayers.foreground: Plush floor cushions and rugs in warm, earthy tones. The dappled sunlight from the exterior is significantly filtered and softened by the overhead canopy.
promptLayers.lighting: Warm, diffused light filters through the woven canopy, creating a soft, ambient glow. Integrated decorative lights provide gentle illumination, avoiding harshness.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A palpable sense of calm and ease, a stark contrast to the festival's main areas. The air feels relaxed and inviting, perfect for unwinding.

forbiddenTransformations: The chill out area becoming as loud and crowded as the festival entrance
The seating being hard and uncomfortable
The lighting becoming bright and direct, negating the 'chill out' effect
The materials appearing synthetic or cheap
The atmosphere turning tense or anxious
Sky being fully visible, without the filtering canopy
Visible festival speakers blasting loud music

v2-1768395893217-mop4q12ag.name: Sculpture Garden at Dusk
v2-1768395893217-mop4q12ag.description: Winding pathways lead through a vibrant outdoor gallery where enigmatic statues begin to emanate their own soft, internal light as dusk settles. The jungle foliage provides a lush backdrop, contrasting with the artificial glow of the art.

formsAndMaterials: vibrant festival banners (repurposed as subtle accents)
colorAndLight: warm yellows, oranges, deep blues, emerald greens
dappled sunlight transitioning to the soft luminescence of glowing sculptures

promptLayers.background: Distant, lush silhouettes of Mayan jungle foliage against a darkening azure sky, with the hints of the festival's distant lights.
promptLayers.midground: A network of sun-dappled paths winding between various art sculptures, some beginning to emit a soft, internal glow. Temporary festival banners might be subtly integrated into displays or as ambient lighting reflectors. Tropical flowers and palm fronds are artfully placed.
promptLayers.foreground: The edge of a pathway, showing hints of soft earth or decorative stone. The base of a partially illuminated sculpture, hinting at its unique form and glowing material.
promptLayers.lighting: The last vestiges of warm afternoon sunlight dappled on the ground, transitioning into the subtle, enchanting luminescence emanating from the art installations themselves. Shadows are softening but still present.
promptLayers.atmosphere: A magical transition from day to night, filled with a sense of wonder and anticipation as the glowing art comes to life against the backdrop of the tropical jungle.

forbiddenTransformations: The glow from the statues becoming harsh or electric.
The jungle foliage obscuring the art.
The pathways becoming indistinct or muddy.
The atmosphere shifting to one of fear or unease.
The statues appearing mundane or static.
Any sign of artificial, non-glowing urban elements.
